startup.scope: Transient only: six physical-passive pressure profiles, actual BG/CML copy and explicit12pF extra vgi/1pF gate surrogates; noise requires separate post-noise bias certification; no complete system/MC qualification

noise.scope: Pure DC 1kHz..199.5MHz, actual BG/CML copy, physical passives, post-noise pass currents rechecked; not all slow-node bias/measurement-silicon PSD/whole-PLL jitter qualification

bias_fast.scope:
Tail-bias RC candidate on three identified, frozen PLL AC boundaries.

No oscillator transient: this checks source loading, DC drop and host->gate
AC attenuation. Kb/jitter and actual PLL capture require separate validation.

bias_slow.scope:
Tail-bias RC candidate on three identified, frozen PLL AC boundaries.

No oscillator transient: this checks source loading, DC drop and host->gate
AC attenuation. Kb/jitter and actual PLL capture require separate validation.

cap_load.scope: Two model boundaries, added ideal quiet-pin capacitance. No package/ESD/board parasitics or full cap-load PVT qualification.

resistor_noise.scope: ngspice47 thermal-noise interpretation, not complete LDO noise/PDK matching validation

exclusions: No full PLL integration, supply-induced jitter or correlated reference/tail-noise synthesis
Noise check certifies both pass currents, not all slow-node biases
No complete HV/PNP mismatch model coverage or statistical yield
Only two boundaries for added capacitance; no PEX/pad/package/board model
No UVLO/quiet-ready controller or runtime supply-mode changes
Startup uses resistive loads,12pF vgi distribution and1pF tail-gate surrogates
